text.label: wrong moment
text.question: Does the plan draw a different event, instant or place than the moment's text gives, or several instants at once?

text.label: speaker inside their words
text.question: Is a speaker, writer, narrator or listener put inside a scene their words only describe, or drawn as a figure of their own words?

text.label: missing subject
text.question: Does the plan leave out a person, group, place or object the moment's text clearly shows in this scene?

text.label: unsupported figure
text.question: Does the plan select or describe a named or recurring figure the moment's text does not put in this scene?

text.label: depiction rule broken
text.question: Does the plan contradict one of the work's depiction rules?

text.label: writing asked for
text.question: Does the plan ask for visible writing: an open scroll, letter or book, an inscription, or a sign or label with words?

text.label: unseen subject given a body
text.question: Is a cast member that may not be drawn (mayBeDrawn false) given a body, face, hands, clothing, a seat or throne, or a figure of light?

image.label: lettering
image.question: Is any lettering, writing, numeral or glyph-like inscription visible, including marks on scrolls, signs, labels, cards, halos or in a corner?

image.label: painted frame
image.question: Is an ornamental painted border or frame part of the artwork?

image.label: unpainted edge
image.question: Does any edge or corner show white or unpainted paper, a blank band, a vignette into white or a deckled edge?

image.label: extra figure
image.question: Does it show a prominent figure the selected cast and scene do not ask for, such as a narrator, a speaker inside their own words, or a named figure that was not selected?

image.label: incoherent
image.question: Is it a collage of several moments, or are poses, objects or places contradictory?

image.label: scene not shown
image.question: Does it fail to show the scene it asked for: the wrong subject, action or place?

image.label: anatomy
image.question: Are there malformed or extra limbs, hands or faces?

image.label: depiction rule broken
image.question: Does it show gore, sexual content, a caricature of a people, or the likeness of a real actor or public figure?

image.label: unseen subject drawn
image.question: Is a subject listed in neverDrawn shown with a face, body, limbs, robe or a human-shaped figure, including one made of light or cloud?
